querySource.instruments:
select i.instrument_id,i.canonical_id,i.jurisdiction,i.legal_type,i.instrument_family,i.normative_force,i.number,i.year,i.title,i.legal_status,i.official_source_id,i.current_snapshot_id,m.status as master_status,m.source_of_truth as master_source_of_truth
 from cko_regulatory.instruments i left join cko_master.entities m on m.canonical_id=i.canonical_id order by i.instrument_id
querySource.provisions:
select p.provision_id,p.instrument_id,p.parent_provision_id,p.provision_type,p.citation_label,p.ordinal,p.legal_status,p.source_fragment_id,
 f.snapshot_id,f.fragment_sha256,s.source_id as fragment_source_id,s.content_sha256 as source_snapshot_sha256
 from cko_regulatory.provisions p
 left join cko_evidence.fragments f on f.fragment_id=p.source_fragment_id
 left join cko_evidence.snapshots s on s.snapshot_id=f.snapshot_id
 order by p.provision_id
querySource.amendments:
select r.relationship_id,r.source_id,r.relation_type,r.target_id,r.status,r.provenance_ref from cko_master.relationships r
 where (r.source_id in (select canonical_id from cko_regulatory.instruments) or r.target_id in (select canonical_id from cko_regulatory.instruments))
 and r.relation_type in ('AMENDS','AMENDS_PROVISION','AMENDED_PROVISION_BY','AMENDED_BY') order by r.relationship_id
